tool.name: FAIRe2MDT
tool.description: format FAIRe metabarcoding data for GBIF's Metabarcoding Data Toolkit

param.name: workbook
param.label: FAIRe metadata workbook
param.help: With projectMetadata, sampleMetadata and experimentRunMetadata sheets, for example a filled-in FAIRe-ator template.

param.name: assay
param.label: Assay name
param.help: As written in assay_name, for example COILeray.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, spaces and _ . + ( ) - only

param.name: seq_run
param.label: Sequencing run ID
param.help: As written in seq_run_id in experimentRunMetadata, for example Library_2021.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, spaces and _ . + ( ) - only

param.name: otu
param.label: OTU or ASV table (otuFinal) for this assay and run
param.help: A seq_id column and one column of read counts per sample. An Excel file (this can be the metadata workbook, if it has an otuFinal sheet), or a TSV or CSV file.

param.name: otu_sheet
param.label: Sheet with the OTU table
param.help: For Excel files only. If the file has one sheet, that sheet is used.

validator.message: A sheet name of up to 31 letters, digits, spaces and _ . , + ( ) # -

param.name: taxa
param.label: Taxonomy table (taxaFinal) for this assay and run
param.help: The FAIRe taxaFinal table: a seq_id column and one column per taxonomic rank or other field. The rows above the seq_id row are skipped.

param.name: taxa_sheet
param.label: Sheet with the taxonomy table
param.help: For Excel files only. If the file has one sheet, that sheet is used.

validator.message: A sheet name of up to 31 letters, digits, spaces and _ . , + ( ) # -

param.name: controls
param.label: Control samples
param.help: Controls are samples whose samp_category is negative control, positive control or PCR standard, or that have a neg_cont_type or pos_cont_type. GBIF does not want them, so they are left out by default, with the sequences that only they have reads of.
param.option: Keep them (their 'missing: not collected' becomes 'not applicable: control sample')

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool converts FAIR eDNA (`FAIRe <https://fair-edna.github.io/>`_) metabarcoding data for one assay and one sequencing run into the Excel workbook that GBIF's `Metabarcoding Data Toolkit (MDT) <https://www.gbif.org/metabarcoding>`_ takes, so that you can publish eDNA occurrence data through GBIF. For a study with several assays or runs, run the tool once for each assay and run.
-----
**Inputs**
- **FAIRe metadata workbook**, with projectMetadata, sampleMetadata and experimentRunMetadata sheets. - **Assay name** and **sequencing run ID**, as written in the workbook. The tool uses only the rows of experimentRunMetadata with exactly this assay_name and seq_run_id (ignoring case). If there are none, it uses a name that differs only in punctuation or case (12S_V5 for 12S-V5), and the log says so. - **OTU or ASV table** (FAIRe *otuFinal*) for this assay and run. This has a seq_id column and one column of read counts for each sample, named as samp_name is in the metadata. If the top-left cell is empty, the first column is taken as seq_id. - **Taxonomy table** (FAIRe *taxaFinal*) for this assay and run.
Both tables can be separate files (Excel, TSV or CSV) or sheets of the metadata workbook. For Excel files, give the sheet names if they are not *otuFinal* and *taxaFinal*.
**Outputs**
- **MDT workbook**, with four sheets:
- *Study*: the projectMetadata terms and values. With several assays, the values for this assay replace the blank project-level values, and assay_name is set to this assay. target_gene is written as the GBIF vocabulary term that MDT uses (12S rRNA (SSU mitochondria) becomes SSU_rRNA_12S_mitochondrial), so that MDT fills in the marker itself. - *Samples*: sampleMetadata joined to the experimentRunMetadata rows of this assay and run, with samp_name renamed id, and without the control samples unless you keep them. Fields with no values are left out. - *Taxonomy*: the taxonomy table, with seq_id renamed id, for the sequences in the OTU table. Fields with no values are left out. - *OTU_table*: the OTU table as given, without the control samples' columns and the sequences that only they have reads of, unless you keep the controls.
- **Log**: what was used, any notes and warnings (for example OTU table columns that are not samples of this run, or sequences missing from the taxonomy table), and the size of each sheet.
Upload the workbook to MDT, which checks it and maps the fields to Darwin Core.
-----
**Differences from running FAIRe2MDT.R by hand**
- This tool matches runs by their exact names. The script also takes names that contain the given name, so COILeray would also take COILeray2, and run1 would take run10. - Excel dates stay dates (2024-03-05, not 45356), and numbers keep the digits Excel shows (105.70852, not 105.70851999999999). - Problems are reported in plain words before the conversion starts. - target_gene is written as the GBIF term, which MDT needs for five of FAIRe's rRNA genes.
@HELP_FAIRE_GUIDE@

This tool runs `FAIRe2MDT <https://github.com/FAIR-eDNA/FAIRe2MDT>`_ (script version 1.1.0) from the FAIR eDNA collaboration. The FAIRe checklist is described in Takahashi et al. (2025) *Environmental DNA* 7: e70100. The Galaxy tool was written by Oliver Berry (CSIRO), with Claude (Anthropic).
